messages.content: I'd like to start the air purifying function in my living room, please set the air conditioner to 'AIR_CLEAN' mode with strongest wind strength, with monitoring.

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Send a command to control an LG ThinQ appliance, such as an air conditioner, by setting various operation modes and target settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the settings and modes to control the LG ThinQ appliance.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable air quality monitoring.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for air cleaning.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable power-saving mode.

coolTargetTemperature.description: The target temperature for cooling in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

targetTemperature.description: The general target temperature in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

message.reasoning: The user wants to start the air purifying function in their living room. They want to set the air conditioner to 'AIR_CLEAN' mode with strongest wind strength, with monitoring. We need to call the ThinQ_Connect function with appropriate arguments. The function expects a dictionary with keys: airConJobMode, windStrength, monitoringEnabled, airCleanOperationMode, powerSaveEnabled, coolTargetTemperature, targetTemperature. The user wants to set airConJobMode to 'AIR_CLEAN', windStrength to strongest (which is "HIGH"? The options are LOW, HIGH, MID. So "HIGH" is strongest). They want monitoring enabled: monitoringEnabled: true. They didn't mention airCleanOperationMode, but we might set it to "POWER_ON". They didn't mention powerSaveEnabled, so we can leave it default or set to false. They didn't mention coolTargetTemperature or targetTemperature. For AIR_CLEAN mode, maybe we don't need targetTemperature. But we can set them to defaults or not include them. The function signature says body: { ... } with optional fields. We can provide only those we want to change. So we will call ThinQ_Connect with body: { airConJobMode: "AIR_CLEAN", windStrength: "HIGH", monitoringEnabled: true, airCleanOperationMode: "POWER_ON" }. That should do it.
